decisions.reason: As the flagship transactional email service, it fits the firm's core cloud messaging direction and strong demand. Its upside remains high, so keeping it open and committing further is justified even though there is no website evidence for 2020 to 2021.

Document capture supports the firm's push into electronic document workflows and had its own page. Its value is still uncertain but plausible, and it runs on existing infrastructure at modest cost, so the option is worth holding.

The email and fax conversion service reuses the established fax and messaging platform and still serves regulated customers who rely on fax. Keeping it costs little, although the slow decline of fax and its low website visibility raise the risk of withdrawal.

This feature sits close to the core fax offering and is cheap to maintain. However, it was only mentioned on the website and is not visible in 2020 to 2021, so it could quietly be folded into the base service; for now there is no clear signal to justify abandoning it.
